# T26 -- Lung-Region Attention Module on ViT-Base -- Module Card

**Backbone:** ViT-Base/16, avg-pool head (timm `vit_base_patch16_224`, ImageNet-pretrained). Sections 1-7 are auto-generated by the notebook (S18); section 8 was added on review, 2026-10-03.

## 1. Selected hyperparameters

- `lambda_att*` = 1.0 (S9; largest lambda_att whose val macro-F1 is within 0.5pp of lam_att_0.0; ties -> higher val ILAR)
- `lambda_bg*` = 1.0 (S11; largest lambda_bg whose val macro-F1 is within 0.5pp of lam_bg_0.0 (plain A2); ties -> higher val ILAR)
- `reduction` = 8 -> +73,921 params (+0.086% of ViT-Base's 85,801,732)

- Protocol: batch 32, early stopping on val_loss, attention init 0.5, spatial-only CBAM (A5), avg-pool head for every arm including A0. Not comparable with the 2026-10-01 local run.

## 3. Acceptance criteria A1-A4 (headline arm: A2_full)

- **[PASS]** A1_attention_matches_lung_mask: 0.9183 (target: Attention-Dice >= 0.80 on test)
- **[PASS]** A2_evidence_inside_lung_up: 0.0980 (target: delta Grad-CAM EIL (post-gate) >= +0.05)
- **[PASS]** A3_mechanism_is_real: 0.0283 (target: delta Grad-CAM EIL (pre-gate) > 0)
- **[PASS]** A4_no_accuracy_tax: -0.0042 (target: delta test macro-F1 >= -1.0pp vs. A0)

## 4. Acceptance criterion A6 (module cost)

- **[PASS]** params +73,921 (0.0862%), GFLOPs +0.014470 (0.0858%)

## 5. Winner selection (design doc section 8)

Candidates (McNemar p>=0.05 AND Wilcoxon p<0.05 vs. A0): ['A2_full', 'A3_multiply', 'A4_guidance_only', 'A5_cbam', 'A6_full_bg']
**ViT-Base's winner: A3_multiply**

## 7. Reproducibility notes

- Data pipeline `t26-vit-avgpool-ramcache-v1`: RAM-cached inputs (bit-identical to disk), a fresh seeded train loader per run, so each arm is reproducible regardless of which session it ran in.
- Checkpoints (`.pt`) are not committed -- record their Kaggle Dataset / Drive URLs here.

## 8. Review notes (added 2026-10-03)

**Run.** Kaggle, Tesla T4, one session of 10.8 h, W&B online (project `chest-xray-disease-classification`).
The executed notebook is `T26_executed_notebook.ipynb`; it is `notebooks/T_26_Vit_Base_Model.ipynb`
with `WANDB_ENTITY` set. No cell raised an error; the pre-flight checks and the A0 sanity gate passed.

**Verified on receipt.**
- All 11 runs (7 arms + A0/A3 at seeds 123 and 2026) predict on exactly the 3,175 test images of
  `artifacts/splits/split_manifest_v1.csv`.
- Accuracy, macro-F1 and macro-AUC recompute exactly from each run's `per_image_predictions.csv`.
- EIL is scored on the same 1,000 images in every run (`cam_subset_indices.json`); for A0, pre-gate and
  post-gate EIL are equal, as they must be.
- Fine-tuning length is comparable across arms (23-36 epochs, early stopping on validation loss).

**Effect sizes vs. A0, seed 42** (paired image-level bootstrap, 95% CI; macro-F1 over the full test
set, EIL over the 1,000-image subset):

| Arm | delta macro-F1 (pp) | delta EIL_post | Images with higher EIL |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1_gate_only | -0.52 [-1.06, -0.02] | -0.033 [-0.037, -0.029] | 23.3% |
| A2_full | -0.42 [-0.93, +0.04] | +0.098 [+0.096, +0.101] | 99.4% |
| A3_multiply | +0.26 [-0.42, +0.87] | +0.573 [+0.564, +0.582] | 99.5% |
| A4_guidance_only | +0.25 [-0.13, +0.63] | -0.003 [-0.005, -0.002] | 35.7% |
| A5_cbam | -0.08 [-0.34, +0.13] | -0.002 [-0.003, -0.002] | 25.0% |
| A6_full_bg | -0.49 [-0.96, -0.06] | +0.097 [+0.095, +0.100] | 99.3% |

A6 vs. A2: delta EIL_post -0.001. Three seeds, A3 vs. A0: delta EIL_post +0.573 / +0.570 / +0.567
(mean +0.570, sd 0.003); delta macro-F1 +0.26 / 0.00 / -0.38 pp (mean -0.04, sd 0.32).

**Caveats.**
1. A0's EIL (0.195) is below the lung-area share of the image (about 0.24), i.e. below what a uniform
   map would score.
2. A3's post-gate EIL is partly mechanical: Grad-CAM reads a map that was already multiplied by the
   lung-shaped attention map. Its pre-gate EIL also rose (+0.377), but on EfficientNet-B0 the same arm
   was more sensitive to background perturbation, and no perturbation test has been run on ViT. Treat
   EIL as evidence of where evidence sits, not of reduced shortcut reliance.
3. The attention map is 14x14 here and 7x7 on the CNN backbones, so attention-Dice and EIL are not
   strictly like-for-like across families.
4. `phase1_lr`, `phase2_lr` and `unfreeze_blocks` were not tuned for ViT.
5. The winner rule's Wilcoxon test is two-sided and reports p = 0.0 (underflow) for every arm, so A4
   and A5 are listed as candidates although their EIL change is slightly negative. Ranking by EIL
   gain makes this harmless for the winner.
6. Absolute GFLOPs (16.87) come from fvcore, which does not count every attention op; the with/without
   delta is what criterion A6 uses.

**Checkpoints.** 11 files, about 343 MB each (`vit_base_patch16_224_<arm>.pt`), not committed. They are
